description: Subscribe a company to ongoing monitoring. Status changes, dissolutions, sanctions matches and corporate events (ES, GB, IE/PL/NO (the last three from 14 Oct 2026) and FI/SE/BE/HR/DK/EE/SK/CH/LV/CY/RO/LT/CA/AU/JP/IL/SG/CO/TW/BR/CZ/DE/US) are scanned daily and POSTed to your webhook_url (HMAC-SHA256 signed). Returns the monitor ID and a webhook_secret (shown once). Available for Spain (ES), the United Kingdom (GB), Ireland (IE), Poland (PL), Norway (NO), Finland (FI), Sweden (SE), Belgium (BE), Croatia (HR), Denmark (DK), Estonia (e-Business Register), Slovakia (RPO), Switzerland (Zefix), Latvia (Register of Enterprises), Cyprus (DRCOR) and Romania (ONRC) only. A dissolution alert fires on the dissolution date the register gives or, where the register gives none (Canada, Israel, Singapore, Taiwan, Romania, many US registrations), when the status first shows closed (detail.date_basis first_seen_closed, else register). This creates a persistent subscription — confirm intent before calling.

company_id.description: Prometiam internal company ID to monitor (from companies_search / company_detail).

country.description: Country of the company to monitor: ES (default), GB, IE, PL, NO, FI, SE, BE, HR, DK, EE, SK, CH, LV, CY, RO, LT, CA, AU, JP, IL, SG, CO, TW, BR, CZ or US. Monitoring is not available for FR.

events.description: Optional list of event types to filter alerts to (default: all).

label.description: Optional human-friendly label for this subscription.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL that receives signed alert POSTs.

name: monitor_subscribe
